policy: These are HTTP/API adapters, not MCP servers. Credentials stay outside the pack. Image/video generation is handled by the unified media MCP.

services.healthCheck: Run web_search.py --json with a non-sensitive test query; missing credentials must fail before network I/O.
services.failureMessage: 未配置 DashScope 时优先使用 Codex 原生网页能力；不要把 API 适配器伪装成 MCP。
services.disableRule: Unset the credential or set the service enabled flag to false in the private connection store.
